relations.text_en: Names Align as an oral care competitor

source.label: Solventum 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Principal multinational competitors within the oral care market include Dentsply Sirona, Envista, and Straumann, all of which compete with both dental and orthodontic solutions, and Ivoclar, which competes with only dental solution offerings, and Align Technology, which competes with only orthodontic solution offerings.

relations.text: 自社株の買い戻し契約(ASR)の相手
relations.text_en: Counterparty to its accelerated share repurchase

source.label: Align Technology 8-K(2026年11月)
source.quote: On November 5, 2026, Align Technology, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), entered into an accelerated share repurchase agreement (the "ASR Contract") with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC ("Goldman Sachs") to repurchase $270 million of the Company's common stock authorized under the Company's $1.0 billion stock repurchase program approved by the Company's Board of Directors in April 2025 (the "Stock Repurchase Program").
